summary: SID and STAR procedures load worldwide in the desktop app, and the website deploys again with the current installer.
releaseNotes: The desktop app draws SIDs, STARs and approaches for every airport in your X-Plane data: procedure requests now reach the Stratos bridge directly.
The website deploys again and its download buttons serve the current installer; it had stopped updating at 2.1.45.
